treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Armenia and the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2016)
eif_quote: [SE list] Lag (2016:927) om skatteavtal mellan Sverige och Armenien ... som Sverige och Armenien undertecknade den 9 februari 2016 || [AM MLI position] ...d on Capital Kingdom of Sweden Original 09-02-2016 29-01-2017
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the AM-SE Convention (MLI_SynthesisedText_Amenia_Sweden.docx, Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership), provided that that company which holds at least 25 per cent of the capital or the voting power of the company paying the dividends; that company which has owned that holding for at least two years prior to any claim being made under this sub-paragraph; and the dividends are exempt from tax in the hands of that company;

5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds at least 10 per cent of the capital or the voting power of the company paying the dividends;
15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the beneficial owner of the royalty is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: [MLI effect] with respect to taxes withheld at source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents, where the event giving rise to such taxes occurs on or after the first day of the next calendar year that begins on or after 30 days after the date of receipt by the Depositary of the notification by Sweden that it has completed its internal procedures for the entry into effect of the provisions of the MLI

notes: Dividend 0% tier: holding >=25% of capital or voting power owned for at least two years before the claim (modelled as 730 days) and dividends exempt for the recipient company. Interest Art. 11(3): taxable only in residence State if payer or recipient is a State/government body/subdivision/local authority/Central Bank, or loan granted/guaranteed by SIDA, SEK, Swedfund, EKN or similar public export/development institution. Art. 29: WHT on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2017-01-29 -> 2018-01-01). MLI: the synthesised text includes MLI Art. 7 PPT, but its entry into effect depends on Sweden's Art. 35(7)(b) notification of completion of internal procedures; per treaty map no such notification has been made, so ppt.applies=false.
unverified: absence of Sweden's Art. 35(7)(b) notification for Armenia as of 2026-10-05 (taken from treaty map)
